cases.about: "She was so beautiful, inside and out," Gary Bardwell told Crime Watch Daily. "She honestly was a special person." https://truecrimedaily.com/2018/04/03/heartbroken-dad-discusses-jessie-bardwells-fatal-relationship-with-killer-boyfriend/
cases.narrative:
On 5/19/2016, her decomposing body was found in a remote area of Farmersville, Texas. She had been wrapped in a sheet and partially covered with bubble wrap.
